Register Individual.description: Registers a new individual in the social registry from an enrolment form.

Register Household Group.description: Registers a new household (group) in the social registry.

Add Member To Household.description: Adds an individual to a household with a membership role.

Remove Member From Household.description: Ends an individual's membership of a household.

Update Individual.description: Updates some fields of an individual; fields left out are unchanged.

Enroll In Program.description: Enrolls a registrant in a program, creating the membership if needed.

Unenroll From Program.description: Exits a registrant's enrolled membership of a program.

Search Individuals.description: Searches individuals by name and date of birth, a page at a time.

Get Household.code:
// Fetch a household by its identifier.
getGroup('urn:openspp:vocab:id-type#household_id|HH-KAM-01');

Search Households.code:
// Households whose name contains 'Household'.
searchGroup({ name: 'Household' }, { count: 20 });

Get Household Members.description: Lists the members of a household, optionally only those with a given role.
Get Household Members.code:
// The head of a household. Leave out role to list every member.
getGroupMembers('urn:openspp:vocab:id-type#household_id|HH-KAM-01', { role: 'head' });

Get Individual's Households.description: Lists every group an individual belongs to, using request() for an endpoint without a named function.

List Programs.code:
// Programs page with a cursor: pass lastId from state.response.page.next for the next page.
getPrograms({ targetType: 'group', count: 10 });

Get Enrolled Programs.description: Lists the programs a household is enrolled in.
Get Enrolled Programs.code:
// Each result is a ProgramMembership with a program reference.
getEnrolledPrograms('Group/urn:openspp:vocab:id-type#household_id|HH-KAM-01');

Get Service Point.description: Gets a service point (pay point / agent) by name.

Search Service Points.description: Finds active service points in a country.
